LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public miner ranking entry ordered by total crypto mined.

userId.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the player.

displayName.description: Public player display name shown on the global leaderboard.

totalSatsMined.description: Total Satoshis mined by the player.

totalBtcMined.description: Total Bitcoin balance/mined amount for display.

hashRateGh.description: Current passive mining speed in GH/s.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the player first joined the leaderboard.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest score sync.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Global leaderboard rankings indexed by player UID, ordered descending by totalSatsMined.
